model.title: Unlocking Native Lands and Opportunities for Commerce and Key Economic Developments Act of 2025
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Brian Schatz (D-HI)

summary.text: The bill would change the rules for leasing tribal trust and restricted land and for granting rights-of-way across Indian land. It would let more tribes be covered by the long-term leasing law, drop some existing limits on lease terms, and allow certain tribes to grant rights-of-way over their own land without federal approval if their tribal regulations are approved by the Interior Secretary. Those tribal regulations would need to include an environmental review process and public comment, and the Secretary would have 180 days to approve or disapprove them. The bill would also set out federal oversight, enforcement, and compliance procedures for these tribal rights-of-way.
